text:
Situation: Octreotide acetate 500 mcg/mL 1 mL vial inventory across three Corvale sites ranges from 17.2 to 25.6 days on hand as of 2026-10-21. FDA's drug shortage list does not include octreotide acetate as of that date.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 1321638 at the manufacturing plant ended on 2026-04-17 and was classified Official Action Indicated (OAI), with the classification known on 2026-07-16. The same plant received a Warning Letter on 2017-03-10 and prior OAI classifications in 2016 and 2022.

Our position: Current stock is limited but not yet critical. No shortage is declared by FDA. The plant's regulatory history warrants proactive sourcing to avoid future disruption.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to execute purchase from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC (ranked option 1) — requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Inc., USA (option 2) as secondary source — requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Buyer to qualify Gland Pharma Limited (option 3) as tertiary source — requires Pharmacy Director approval.
4. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list and plant inspection outcomes weekly — requires Buyer compliance.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement until inventory falls below 14 days; relying solely on current supplier given its OAI history; initiating clinical protocol changes without committee review.
